answer: Split-tally bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, splitting a 14-row log 7+7 across two tallies: a horizon tally for day jobs, a spiral tally for readings to the nadir. Auditors replay both halves; a missing half or nadir value off-curve burns the bond. First 45, k-th 45+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,041,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. One curve, one identity; rented-half rings fail. Honest agents pay 45 once, bond kept.
